title: Highway Maintenance Workers
description: Maintain highways, municipal and rural roads, airport runways, and rights-of-way. Duties include patching broken or eroded pavement and repairing guard rails, highway markers, and snow fences. May also mow or clear brush from along road, or plow snow from roadway.

tasks.text: Set out signs and cones around work areas to divert traffic.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Directing live traffic requires physical presence

dwas.name: Direct vehicle traffic.

tasks.text: Flag motorists to warn them of obstacles or repair work ahead.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Directing live traffic requires physical presence

dwas.name: Direct vehicle traffic.

tasks.text: Perform preventative maintenance on vehicles and heavy equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of mechanical equipment

dwas.name: Maintain mechanical equipment.

tasks.text: Drive trucks to transport crews and equipment to work sites.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Truck driving needs real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Drive trucks or truck-mounted equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Erect, install, or repair guardrails, road shoulders, berms, highway markers, warning signals, and highway lighting, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fence installation requires manual digging and fitting

dwas.name: Install fencing or other barriers.

tasks.text: Clean and clear debris from culverts, catch basins, drop inlets, ditches, and other drain structures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual clearing of debris and vegetation outdoors

dwas.name: Remove debris or vegetation from work sites.

tasks.text: Drive heavy equipment and vehicles with adjustable attachments to sweep debris from paved surfaces, mow grass and weeds, remove snow and ice, and spread salt and sand.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Vehicles and equipment driven in unstructured sites

dwas.name: Operate equipment or vehicles to clear construction sites or move materials.

tasks.text: Haul and spread sand, gravel, and clay to fill washouts and repair road shoulders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of construction materials on site

dwas.name: Spread sand, dirt or other loose materials onto surfaces.
Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Inspect, clean, and repair drainage systems, bridges, tunnels, and other structures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Direct physical inspection of industrial equipment

dwas.name: Inspect industrial or commercial equipment to ensure proper operation.
Clean equipment or facilities.
Maintain plumbing structures or fixtures.

tasks.text: Remove litter and debris from roadways, including debris from rock and mud slides.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual clearing of debris and vegetation outdoors

dwas.name: Remove debris or vegetation from work sites.

tasks.text: Dump, spread, and tamp asphalt, using pneumatic tampers, to repair joints and patch broken pavement.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Pour materials into or on designated areas.
Compact materials to create level bases.
Spread concrete or other aggregate mixtures.

tasks.text: Perform roadside landscaping work, such as clearing weeds and brush, and planting and trimming trees.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual clearing of debris and vegetation outdoors

dwas.name: Remove debris or vegetation from work sites.

tasks.text: Apply poisons along roadsides and in animal burrows to eliminate unwanted roadside vegetation and rodents.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Treating greenery is physical application work

dwas.name: Treat greenery or surfaces with protective substances.

tasks.text: Measure and mark locations for installation of markers, using tape, string, or chalk.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical site dimension measurement

dwas.name: Measure work site dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.text: Paint traffic control lines and place pavement traffic messages, by hand or using machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying paint requires physical brush or spray work

dwas.name: Apply paint to surfaces.

tasks.text: Apply oil to road surfaces, using sprayers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Road-surfacing equipment operated manually

dwas.name: Operate road-surfacing equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect markers to verify accurate installation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installation inspection requires on-site physical check

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper installation.

tasks.text: Place and remove snow fences used to prevent the accumulation of drifting snow on highways.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Dismantling structures is heavy physical labor

dwas.name: Install fencing or other barriers.
Dismantle equipment or temporary structures.

tasks.text: Blend compounds to form adhesive mixtures used for marker installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.
